overview: This Senate resolution names the majority party's members of Senate committees for the 119th Congress (2025 to 2026), including the chair of each committee. It covers about 20 committees, such as Appropriations, Armed Services, Finance, Foreign Relations, Judiciary, Intelligence, and Veterans' Affairs. A few seats were left blank, to be filled later. Committees are where most bills are first reviewed and changed, so these assignments decide who leads and shapes work on each issue. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on January 7, 2025.
for: Supporters say setting committee rosters promptly lets the Senate start holding hearings and reviewing bills at the start of the new Congress.
against: Critics say the resolution is routine organizational business that does not change any law or policy.
